## What

Compare the commits of a pull request with each other, and pick them graphically on the Activity page. Real-use trigger: in the owner's board repository a user had to open a throwaway PR just to get a snapshot of an older commit of another PR.

- **Snapshots per PR push**: a light snapshot of the head commit (same content as `history/`) under `pr-<N>/commits/<sha7>/`; input `pr-commits` (default 20 per PR, `0` = off). Kept when the PR page is replaced, pruned by `portal.py index --keep-pr-commits`, removed with the PR by the existing cleanup workflow. They show in `builds.json` as kind `commit` with `pr` and `published`.
- **PR page, tab Commits**: strip of the pushes with comment counts, click A and B, inline compare (`compare.html?embed=1`) with a summary line and "Comments between A and B".
- **compare.html**: a group "Commits of PR #N" per PR; embed mode.
- **Activity page**: events (PRs, reviews, comments, issues, releases) interleaved in the graph, Show checkboxes, A/B selection bar with Compare A <-> B, greyed commits without snapshot with a tooltip, keyboard (Enter, `a`, `b`), side panel with the commit message, its PR (description, comments, review comments, pinned board comments) and the issues it mentions with their comments.
- **activity.py**: PR bodies and comments, review comments, pinned comments parsed from the `kicad-hub-pin` marker, issues mentioned by commits and PRs (aliased GraphQL, max 40, skipped when the rate limit is low or issues are off) and their comments; the texts go to `activity-details.json` (capped at about 2.5 MB), `activity.json` stays light. No e-mail is published.
- Docs: README, manual (Activity, Compare, how to compare the commits of a PR), ROADMAP.
- Template and test workflows get `issues: read` (needed for issues in private repositories).

## Limits

- One snapshot per push (its head commit), built from the PR merged into its base at that time, like `pr-N/`.
- PRs pushed before this has no snapshots until their next push.
- The mockup's "N parts moved" needs placement data the CI does not export: the summary shows pushes apart, BOM changes and pages that differ.

## Test

Checked in GitHub Actions only (test workflow on this PR, Docs screenshots workflow); results in the PR comments.

Click a wire, bus, junction, label, power symbol or pin in the schematic viewer to get its net: highlighted on the sheet (the rest dims) and on the other sheets it runs through, with the "Net in the schematic" card (Prev / Next sheet, Show on PCB). Works with Sync, and the PCB's Show in schematic now highlights the net natively.

- **Fork of KiCanvas** vendored in `scripts/vendor/kicanvas.js` (JMcordobamendez/kicanvas, `feat/schematic-net-select`, on top of upstream b031159 = the build we had; commit, run and sha256 in `scripts/vendor/README.md`). It builds the schematic's connectivity (wires, junctions, labels by scope, power symbols, sheet pins, bus members, invisible power pins), picks items, and has `viewer.highlight_net()`. Lint, 109+ unit tests and 9 viewer tests pass in the fork's CI.
- `crossprobe.js` uses it; a viewer without it falls back to the old rings.
- A net of the board is its schematic net by the pins on its pads, so names don't have to match. Names follow KiCad's rules: on the example board 66 of 68 nets with pins get the board's name (the other 2 are bus nets).
- Checked in a real browser with the "Docs screenshots" workflow, `xprobe` page (clicks a wire, a label and a pin; Show on PCB; next sheet; Esc; API; Sync): no console errors.
- Docs: README, manual 5.2/5.3, ROADMAP (item, fork and upstream decision).
- Upstream: not offered. The maintainer of theacodes/kicanvas said on 2026-10-14 he won't accept LLM-assisted code, and it has been quiet since April. Owner's call.

## What

An **Activity** page (`/activity.html`) in the design portal: how the work evolved.

- SVG lane graph (no dependencies) of the last `activity` commits (default 500) of all branches and tags, newest on top, one colour per lane, Bezier merge curves, release markers, branch/tag chips with the branch creator's avatar; aligned with a table (subject, author, date, sha).

Push log `activity-pushes.json` kept in the site branch (push events and updates of PR branches), since-install only, says so on the page.
- **No e-mail addresses published**: login from noreply addresses or GitHub, else the git name; free text scrubbed.
- New input `activity` (default 500, 0 = off); links from the front page, the build pages' top bar and compare.html; README, template workflow and ROADMAP updated.

## Timeline of main and compare any two versions

- **History of main**: new input `history` (default 10, `0` = off). Each push to the default branch adds a light snapshot at `/history/<short-sha>/` (design files if under 6 MB, page renders, parts BOM, commit sha/date/author/message; no fab zip, PDFs or offers). Pruned to the newest N on every publish (`portal.py index --keep-history`).
- **Renders for client-side compare**: new step "Page renders (compare)" + `scripts/renders.py`. Every published build (main, history, releases, PRs) stores `renders/` with a full-page PNG per schematic sheet and PCB layer, exported with the same options as the visual diff (`--page-size-mode 0`, black and white PCB), fixed resolution (rasterized at 300 dpi, reduced to 200 dpi for schematics and 250 dpi for PCB layers; A4 = 2339 / 2923 px wide), no content-dependent crop; `renders/renders.json` lists them with a content hash. Also `bom-parts.csv` and commit info in `build.json`.
- **`compare.html`** at the site root (`?a=<path>&b=<path>`): BOM diff in JS, and per sheet/layer the interactive widget (Swipe / Fade / Side by side / Changes, wheel zoom, drag pan). "Changes" is a canvas pixel diff (threshold 48, red only in A, green only in B). Identical pages (same hash, or no pixel difference) are collapsed as "no changes". Builds without renders get a clear message.
- The widget moved to a shared `assets/compare.js`, used by `portal.html` (PR "Changes" tab) and `compare.html`.
- **Timeline UI**: "History" view on the front page (`#history`) with Open / Compare with previous / Compare with…; version picker in the portal lists history and has "All history…" and "Compare this with…".
- Cleanup workflow: same jq rebuild (a build's `build.json` + `path`), only a comment updated in both copies.
- README, `template/.github/workflows/kicad.yml` (commented option) and ROADMAP updated.

Example board: 16 renders (5 sheets, 11 layers), 1.1 MB in total, 188 KB the largest.

Only checkable after merge: snapshots under `/history/` and their pruning (they come from pushes to main). On this PR the compare page can be tried between PR builds that have renders.
